project.body:
# YLTE — Yanling Transit Expansion

YLTE is the Minecraft 1.21.1 continuation of Aphrodite's Nemo's Transit Expansion (ANTE). It adds custom models, JavaScript rendering, decorative objects and rail tools to YanlingMTR / MTR.

## Install

Use Java 21 and the matching Fabric or NeoForge build. Install YanlingMTR 1.0.3 and Architectury API; Fabric also requires Fabric API. Install matching YLTE versions on the server and clients. The loader accepts MTR compatibility versions from `1.21.1-3.3.4`, but not every third-party fork has been tested.

Replace the old ANTE JAR. The `mtrsteamloco` ID, resource namespaces, Java/script interfaces, `ANTE_FLAG`, save keys and protocol 11 are unchanged. Back up your world, configuration and resource packs before upgrading.

## Version 1.1.1

The version no longer uses a beta suffix. This update fixes pinyin search, string-map encoding, direct-node editing, train configuration IDs, route-tool and held-decoration persistence, and server-side edit validation. It includes the earlier brush and bundled GraalJS runtime fixes. Pinyin uses Apache-2.0 libraries instead of JPinyin.

Update both clients and servers. New `YLTE-SM1:` string values require the new decoder; older versions may not read them. Previously lost or corrupted data requires a backup. Build and local native-client checks do not cover every modpack, dedicated multiplayer server or shader pack.

## Minecraft 26.2

YLTE is the standalone 1.21.1 line. The newer 26.2 ANTE work lives in YanlingMTR's source repository and unified build; these versions are not interchangeable.

## Credits and license

Based on [Aphrodite's Nemo's Transit Expansion](https://github.com/aphrodite281/mtr-ante) by Aphrodite281 and [Nemo's Transit Expansion](https://github.com/zbx1425/mtr-nte) by Zbx1425 and contributors. Maintained by linlunaire as an independent community continuation. Original MIT attribution is retained. Bundled Noto fonts use SIL OFL 1.1; pinyin libraries use Apache-2.0, with MIT dictionary data. Bundled runtime notices are included in the JAR and source tree. Repository URLs and historical tags are unchanged.
